text: Ah. Footsteps. Not many make the climb.
I keep the light. The light keeps the sea honest. Mostly.

choices.text: Why keep a light at all?
Nessa says there's something shiny up here.

text: On a clear day? The nearest is {nearest_island}.
Beyond that, more than I can count. Some I've watched for forty years. Some appeared last spring.
Islands don't appear, captain. And yet.
So ships find home. And so whatever is out past the reef knows we're still here, still watching.
I'm not sure which purpose matters more these days.
Hm. A few coins I set aside for whoever bothered to climb up here. East side, by the cliff edge.
Consider it a reward for curiosity. The sea rewards it too, though not always kindly.

bye.text: Watch the horizon, captain. It's watching you.
